data.content_ref: inline:The statement names a dependence relation and states a refutation condition, but the refutation does not actually address whether the dependence holds; it describes a self-inflicted bottleneck (coordination overhead from the N-version programming used to implement Synthetic Diversity) creating a Herding Effect. This refutes the implementation strategy, not the dependence of large-service resilience on Synthetic Diversity. A valid refutation would need to show that resilience does not in fact depend on such simulated entropy; the provided refutation instead concedes the dependence and attacks a chosen means of realizing it.
